theorems.name: Submission.dmcbr_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_local_reps
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P k), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, X ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ) → (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep W k), IsOpen W ∧ x ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ U ∧ μ.restrict W = R.measure ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, y ∈ W → ξ y = R.orient y) → IsIntegerMultiplicity X
